instruction: Create a concise factual project summary using only information supported by the stakeholder input.
input: ChartMorrow Amendment Review overview: The project reviews patient health-record amendment requests using intake, author, privacy, and governance inputs. Patients submit requests with entry, correction, and reason details; records intake clerks check completeness and record evidence; clinical authors record positions and rationales; privacy reviewers record privacy impact; and records governance officers record approved or declined decisions after all required inputs are present. Evidence types, post-approval visibility of erroneous sensitive text, the correction-applying role, and the decision deadline are unresolved. Changing a clinical diagnosis is outside the project.

output.summary: ChartMorrow Amendment Review reviews patient health-record amendment requests using intake, author, privacy, and governance inputs. Patients submit requests, Records Intake Clerks check completeness and record evidence, Clinical Authors record positions and rationales, Privacy Reviewers record privacy impact, and Records Governance Officers record final decisions after the required inputs are present. Evidence types, sensitive-text visibility, correction ownership, and decision timing remain unresolved, while changing a clinical diagnosis is excluded.
output.primary_goal: Review patient health-record amendment requests using intake, author, privacy, and governance inputs.
key_capabilities: Submit amendment requests with entry, correction, and reason details.
Check request completeness and record supporting evidence.
Record Clinical Author positions and rationales.
Record approved or declined decisions after required inputs are present.
unresolved_points: Whether erroneous sensitive text remains visible to routine staff after approval.
Which role applies an approved correction.
What maximum time applies to issuing an amendment decision.
